_provenance: Contrast pairs for harness proposal marks and proposal check's rare-form advisory. The shares the code acts on are derived from gt/ocr/ at run time; each note is a dated observation supporting the row. The Jesup pairs (g-dot, the small capitals, caron-c) are that notation's and do not occur here.

contrasts.name: dje-ending-yn
contrasts.note: 2026-11-16, 93 restored pages: -ђын 80, -ӄын 0; The Chukchee -g̣ɪn 169, -qɪn 0. Readers take ђ and ӄ for each other both ways (materials-reader), and 1-175's мі́рӄын for мі́рђын reached the editor.

contrasts.name: qa-diminutive
contrasts.note: 2026-11-16: the diminutive -ӄај/-ӄӓј 18, -ђај 0; The Chukchee -qai 32, -g̣ai 0. Marks are dropped before the ending is compared, so -ӄӓј counts.

contrasts.name: qa-adjective
contrasts.note: 2026-11-16: -ӄін/-ӄен after ны-/ні-/не- 8, -ђін/-ђен there 0 (ныкіlвэ́јӄін, нена́реӄен); The Chukchee nɪ-…-qin/-qen 23. Without the prefix there is no prior (-ӄін 1, -ђін 2), which is why the prefix scopes it.

_stem_boundary: The book prints ’ between a native stem and its Russian case ending (Ајӈан̀ва́т’омъ, Ајӈан̀ва́т’а, 1-022), so the stem is the native form and the lexicon keys it once, not once per case (marks.stem).
